string.text: Gloomy wants to find out whether snorks can be lured out with a harmonica. He needs three for his hunters and a spare set.
Gloomy is testing sound lures on snorks. He needs three harmonicas for field trials.
The North Loop caravan supplies several remote camps. The stalkers have asked for three guitars, one for each staging base.
North Loop is assembling a shipment for remote camps. Three guitars have been ordered for this trip.
Ladoga is assigning two additional patrols to the camp approaches. They need two pairs of binoculars to watch the road from covered positions.
Ladoga is strengthening surveillance around the camp. Two patrol teams need binoculars.
Arsen Long is collecting musical instruments for barter between stalker bases. The order calls for six guitars and four harmonicas. The shipment must be delivered in full.
Arsen is buying instruments for barter at the bases. He needs a batch of six guitars and four harmonicas.
The Storm Petrel outpost is replacing optics at three observation points. Three pairs of binoculars are needed for the duty shifts.
Storm Petrel is supplying three observation points. Each needs a pair of binoculars.

Arsen Long is preparing mixed cargo for barter at a remote base. The buyers are waiting for four guitars, three harmonicas and two pairs of binoculars. The shipment will leave once the whole batch is collected.
Arsen needs four guitars, three harmonicas and two pairs of binoculars for barter at a remote base. Only the complete shipment will be accepted.
